NINTEC360 / ONE SYSTEM, THE ENTIRE JOURNEY

Customer service,
operations and
sales outreach.

Nintec360 is an AI agent for calls, WhatsApp and email, including outside business hours. It qualifies enquiries and, following your business rules, can guide purchases, handle payments, book appointments or hand over. It then follows up and runs campaigns. Your CRM keeps the context and outcome.

01 / BEFORE / NEW CONTACTS

Every contact enters the system.

THE PROBLEM
Website leads, ad responses and enquiries arrive through different channels.
WHAT NINTEC360 DOES
Receives enquiries from forms, calls, WhatsApp or email and initiates the first contact.
WHAT YOU GAIN
Your team has a shared starting point for every opportunity.

IN THE CRM Contact source · Channel · Customer details

02 / DURING / UNDERSTAND AND RESOLVE

Turn an enquiry into a clear understanding of what’s needed.

THE PROBLEM
Customers call outside business hours, or your team answers the same questions over and over.
WHAT NINTEC360 DOES
Responds, understands the context and language, checks your business information and qualifies the enquiry.
WHAT YOU GAIN
Customers can move forward without waiting for your team to be available.

IN THE CRM Customer need · Conversation summary · Qualification

03 / DURING / TAKE ACTION

From “yes” to a purchase, booking or handoff.

THE PROBLEM
The customer has decided, but still needs to pay, confirm a booking or arrange the next step.
WHAT NINTEC360 DOES
Depending on your workflow, it guides the customer through to purchase or payment and records the order. It can also check availability, book appointments or reservations, and hand over with context when needed.
WHAT YOU GAIN
Customers can complete the action within the same sales process. Your team receives the outcome and knows what needs to happen next.

IN THE CRM Product or service · Payment status · Order, appointment or booking · Owner

04 / AFTER / KEEP THINGS MOVING

Every open task has a next step.

THE PROBLEM
A customer hasn’t replied, a payment is outstanding or an order needs follow-up.
WHAT NINTEC360 DOES
Gets back in touch, sends appointment or payment reminders, and follows up on purchases according to your business rules.
WHAT YOU GAIN
Follow-up no longer depends on remembering to chase every customer.

IN THE CRM Task status · Outstanding task · Scheduled action · Response

05 / AFTER / BUILD THE RELATIONSHIP

The service ends. The relationship can continue.

THE PROBLEM
After delivering a service, there isn’t always time to gather feedback or stay in touch.
WHAT NINTEC360 DOES
Checks in on the customer’s experience, makes it easy to request a review and runs loyalty activities.
WHAT YOU GAIN
Your business can understand the customer’s experience and keep the relationship going.

IN THE CRM Service completed · Feedback · History

06 / START AGAIN / SALES OUTREACH

Your database can start conversations, too.

THE PROBLEM
You have past customers or prospect groups you never get back in touch with.
WHAT NINTEC360 DOES
Runs targeted campaigns at scale to re-engage customers, build loyalty or reach prospects, and handles the replies.
WHAT YOU GAIN
You create new sales conversations that feed back into the same service and management cycle.

IN THE CRM Segment · Source campaign · Contact outcome

AT THE CENTRE / VISIBILITY THROUGHOUT THE CYCLE

Know where every customer came from and where they stand.

THE PROBLEM
Conversations and campaigns leave information scattered across systems. It’s hard to know what’s been done and what’s still open.
WHAT NINTEC360 DOES
Records the channel, source, summary, status and actions. It can update your CRM and give your team the context they need.
WHAT YOU GAIN
A clear view of every customer relationship, so you can decide when to step in and what to do next.

IN THE CRM Source · History · Status · Owner · Outcome · Next action

BEFORE YOU DECIDE

The questions
that matter.

Good automation also makes its limits clear.

How does it connect WhatsApp, email and a CRM?

Nintec360 connects your configured channels with your business information. Conversations can update the CRM, create an appointment or trigger follow-up. We review the connections to your existing tools before implementation.

Can it make automated outbound calls?

Yes. It can initiate calls for reminders, follow-up or re-engagement campaigns. Your business defines the contacts, goal, channel and rules; replies and next actions are recorded.

What happens when a person is needed?

Nintec360 can transfer or hand over a conversation when human input is needed. Together, we define the handoff criteria and the information your team should receive.

Does it replace my CRM?

It can work with the CRM or ERP you already use. It records interactions and can update customer information through the relevant connection. We check the fit before implementation.

Do campaigns handle replies too?

Yes. A campaign can reach out to a segment, and Nintec360 can handle replies, qualify interest, book appointments or hand over to your team. Each outcome is linked to the customer and source campaign.

Can I decide what it automates?

Yes. We configure the services, questions it can answer, permitted actions and follow-up conditions. Your team continues to decide how the business operates.

How is information protected?

The product uses encrypted communications, authentication, permissions and activity logs. During the audit, we can review data processing and the requirements relevant to your situation, using the GDPR, Spain’s LOPDGDD and the EU AI Act as reference frameworks. We do not claim certifications we have not obtained.

How much does it cost, and how long does setup take?

It depends on the channels, tasks and integrations you need. During the audit, we define the scope and next steps for a proposal. There is no single published price or delivery timeline.

Would it work for my business?

It’s worth exploring if you handle enquiries, leads, appointments, repetitive follow-up or sales campaigns. Show us a real workflow, and we’ll assess what can be automated and what should stay with your team.
